run_generation_with_model: run text generation using a PyTorch model with input token IDs and stopping criteria
create_ChameleonGenerator_instance: create a ChameleonGenerator with a model, input IDs, and optional logits processors for token generation
iterate_tokens_with_ChameleonGenerator: iterate over generated tokens one at a time using the ChameleonGenerator iterator
configure_token_selector: configure a custom TokenSelector like MultinomialTokenSelector for sampling tokens during generation
stream_tokens_with_run_generation: stream generated tokens in real time using a BaseStreamer with the run_generation function
